dialogues.speaker: Titu
dialogues.text: Hmmm... I... can't believe that happened... It's almost as if I've had a long, long dream.

dialogues.speaker: Titu
dialogues.text: Strange... I am not someone who should have appeared in the "present"... Sorry, I know you might not understand, but I... have had many pasts, so many memories of lives led... But none of them "me."

dialogues.speaker: Titu
dialogues.text: The life of the one named "Titu" was akin to a dream in which he could not control his own body, a dream from which he has only just awakened... Only now does he hear the Lord of the Night's call...

dialogues.speaker: Titu
dialogues.text: Was this... your doing? That sense of being controlled has faded. Hmm... Yes. Perhaps this shall be the final life of the one named "Titu."

dialogues.speaker: Titu
dialogues.text: Thank you, outlander hero... Haha. Let's live this life out in peace, shall we? Being a storyteller sounds pretty sweet in that regard...
